source_policy: exactly one active source: paste, upload, or saved project; irrelevant source branches are discarded after selection
writing_quality: en-GB browser spellcheck plus conservative backend spelling/grammar check for every pasted/uploaded/project source; original uploads preserved
document_workflow: source -> AI brief fill -> only unresolved/important review -> automatic save -> Create Now or Gold Standard -> result -> Change with AI with version lineage
speed_policy: route-first checks; document jobs do not probe unrelated development services; fast health endpoint; async long document jobs
settings_policy: human-facing settings first; technical controls under Advanced; superseded duplicates removed

installer_security: explicit user approval + exact-package SHA-256 trust + audit/revoke; no Defender exclusions; no ExecutionPolicy Bypass in normal install path
saved_project_source: read-only local SQLite snapshot first; Core HTTP optional fallback; downstream intake independent of Core after snapshot
installer_test_isolation: AGAPE_CORE_DB is authoritative; install tests use isolated temp Core DB path and cannot read live project data
project_recovery: automatic safe merge of historic dmt_core.sqlite3 and dmt_memory.sqlite3 user projects; current DB backed up first; manual rescan available in Projects; explicit roots under Windows %TEMP% are supported
core_database_selection: newest healthy canonical Core database; explicit AGAPE_CORE_DB remains authoritative
provider_reliability: short live preflight before long AI work; stale subscription CLI paths invalidated; Ollama live-probe + bounded local fallback
activity_sync: delegated workflow PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED mirrored into Mainframe events once per run
source_prepare_reliability: request persisted outside SQLite; abandoned RUNNING jobs resume after Mainframe restart; workflow intake idempotent by prepare_request_id; browser reconnect bounded
review_reliability: selected reviewers are runtime-preflighted; healthy Ollama fallback is used when needed; unavailable or failed optional review never discards an already validated document
saved_project_context: deterministic high-confidence source facts preserved before/after AI fill; substantive assistant summaries allowed as secondary context; generic boilerplate/raw JSON excluded
runtime_cutover: explicit stop marker for V4.6+ watchdogs; verified legacy visible-server parent termination for V4.3-V4.5; LISTENING ports verified free before activation
validation_reliability: missing required sections remain a hard gate; short sections are repaired individually against explicit minimum/target sizes; if all headings exist but a section remains short after repair, the generated document is preserved with a validation warning instead of discarded
coding_tools: Separate coding-model, coding-agent and code-manager choices; Aider/OpenHands/Open Interpreter/Agape Native/Compare agent options; Agape/Theia Lite/Theia Full/VS Code manager options; Settings can install VS Code and open the official Theia download.
coding_model_policy: Coding tasks default to Auto - coding specialist; local-first, cloud-first and manual modes remain selectable.
qa_automation: 111 automated regression tests plus 22-step isolated full dummy QA. GitHub CI/release gates run the full dummy QA before publishing.
workspace: V5.1: Workspace project/result tree, centre preview, persistent to-do and recent jobs plus context-sensitive right-click menus for projects, results/jobs and to-dos.
right_click_menus: Projects: Open/Use as source/Add to-do/Copy; jobs: Open/Resume/Add to-do/Copy; to-dos: complete/reopen/edit/copy/delete; blank workspace: refresh/add to-do/collapse.
testing_tools: Optional Settings/installer testing-tool manager: axe, Schemathesis, OWASP ZAP, Lighthouse CI, k6, Appium Windows, Appium Android. No silent installs.
download_reliability: finished-result proxy follows the active Workflow Bridge endpoint (8852), preserves upstream HTTP errors, and is covered by DOCX/PDF byte-validation plus retry QA.
review_ui: missing-information and Change brief with AI sections are collapsed by default; research has dedicated progress; Download Manager exposes stages, progress, ETA, instructions, retry, download-again and open-folder actions.
